# wso2is_notification_template (Resource)

Customizes an email or SMS notification template in one language (locale). The template applies to the whole organization or to one application. When you destroy the resource, the server goes back to the system template.

Templates use placeholders, such as `{{user-name}}`, `{{confirmation-code}}`, `{{organization-name}}` and `{{ url:...}}`. Template types include `AccountConfirmation`, `AskPassword`, `PasswordReset`, `passwordResetSucess`, `ResendAccountConfirmation`, `EmailOTP`, `SMSOTP`, `AccountLockFailedAttempt`, `AccountUnlockAdmin`, `AccountDisable`, `OrganizationUserInvitation`, `magicLink` and `TemporaryPassword`. You can also use your own types from `wso2is_notification_template_type`. To import, use the ID `<channel>/<type>/<locale>` or `<channel>/<type>/<locale>/<application_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_notification_template" "account_confirmation_fr" {
  channel = "email"
  type    = "AccountConfirmation"
  locale  = "fr_FR"
  subject = "Confirmez votre compte"
  body    = "<p>Bonjour {{user-name}}, confirmez votre compte : <a href=\"{{carbon.product-url}}/accountrecoveryendpoint/confirmregistration.do?confirmation={{confirmation-code}}\">confirmer</a></p>"
}

resource "wso2is_notification_template" "sms_otp" {
  channel = "sms"
  type    = "SMSOTP"
  body    = "Your Acme code is {{confirmation-code}}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) Message body (HTML for email).
- `channel` (String) `email` or `sms`.
- `type` (String) Template type name, for example `AccountConfirmation`.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application that this template is for. When it is not set, the template is the organization's template.
- `content_type` (String) Email content type. The default is `text/html`.
- `footer` (String) Email footer.
- `locale` (String) Locale such as `en_US` or `fr_FR`. The default is `en_US`.
- `subject` (String) Email subject (email templates).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<channel>/<type>/<locale>[/<application_id>]`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_notification_template.account_confirmation_fr email/AccountConfirmation/fr_FR
```
